comment: Graphviz / DOT editing behaviour — the non-highlighting half of the
language contribution declared in package.json.
Strict JSON, for the same reason as the PlantUML configuration beside it:
VS Code would accept `//` comments here, but a file that also survives a
plain JSON.parse is cheaper to test. The prose lives in this ignored key.
The one decision worth writing down:
* `<` and `>` are NOT declared as brackets. In DOT they delimit an
HTML-like label (`label=<hi>`) and would look like a natural
pair — but every edge in the file is spelled `->`, and a bracket pair
makes bracket-pair colourisation treat each of those `>` characters as
a closer with no opener. A graph of two hundred edges then reads as two
hundred bracket errors. They are listed as an auto-closing and a
surrounding pair instead, where the `>` of `->` is never involved:
auto-closing only fires on a typed `<`, and surrounding only on a
selection.
* `.dot` is claimed by package.json even though the md family's own note
(port spec §4.4, F-45) says the extension is deliberately left alone
because the operating system already registers it as a Word template.
That is a package.json decision, not one this file can make; it is
recorded here so the reasoning is not lost.
No wordPattern is set: DOT's ID grammar (`[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*`, plus
numerals) is already exactly VS Code's default word class, so overriding it
would only introduce a way to be wrong.
